what: A fitted camera for the desk plane of public/plates/original/desk-plate.jpg, measured by hand on the 736 x 672 photo. A STARTING POINT for Patch 03 (the match lab), not its result. Every number is a design assumption about an unknown real scene except where marked 'measured'.
units: cm in the world, photo pixels in the image. The desk top is the plane Y = 0. X is measured from the camera centre line (positive right). Zd is measured from the FRONT edge of the desk top towards the wall.
model: pinhole camera looking horizontally, principal point (cx, horizonY). Equivalent to a camera pitched DOWN by pitchDegEquivalent with the principal point at the image centre.

equivalentToThePatch03Sliders.note: With the principal point at the image centre (y = 336), the horizon sits at y = 268 only if the camera looks DOWN by about 3.1 degrees: atan((336 - 268) / 1263). The photo's verticals stay vertical to within about 4 px over 300 px, so either a 3.1 degree pitch or a pure vertical lens shift reproduces it.

measuredOnThePhoto.horizonYFromTheDepthLines: about 264 to 272 (the desk's side edges converge there)
measuredOnThePhoto.frontApronFaceY: 483.5 to about 495 (the vertical face under the desk top; NOT desk top)

scaleAssumption.why: Chosen so a 3-monitor group is about 45 cm each and the keyboard about 32 cm. A design assumption: the photo has no known real size.

crossChecks.note: The back corners were NOT used in the fit; the model predicts them within 1.3 px. The lamp base and the speaker come out at believable sizes (11 and 16 cm).

pile.why: between the lamp (x 105-150) and the keyboard mat (x 300+), clear of the chair

riser.why: front edge of the right end, in front of the speaker; the chair's right edge reaches about X = +65 at the desk front
